source.title: Matrices with Compliance Comparable to that of Brain Tissue Select Neuronal over Glial Growth in Mixed Cortical Cultures

material: Polyacrylamide gel, soft (7.5% acrylamide, 0.01% bis-acrylamide), laminin-coated

formulation.evidence: solutions are prepared to contain a constant polymer mass of 7.5% and bis-acrylamide concentrations of 0.01%, 0.03% or 0.3% to alter stiffness

formulation.component: acrylic acid N-hydroxy succinimide ester in toluene
formulation.evidence: toluene containing 0.5% acrylic acid N-hydroxy succinimide ester

processing.evidence: The N-succinimidyl acrylate incorporated at the surface of the gel was reacted with 0.2 mg/ml laminin
calculated from the shear stress in phase with a 2% oscillatory (1 rad/s) shear strain

biology.cell_type: embryonic (E17-E19) rat cortical neurons and astrocytes, mixed culture

culture_days.evidence: Mixed cultures of cortical neurons and astrocytes were imaged 7 days after plating on laminin-coated PA gels.

other_outcomes.evidence: Results show that ;80% of cells on soft gels were bIII-tubulin positive
other_outcomes.name: fraction of cells bIII-tubulin positive (neurons)

other_outcomes.evidence: neurons on soft gels have 30% more F-actin structures extending off the length of the neurite
other_outcomes.name: F-actin structures along neurite vs hard gels

notes: Shear modulus by oscillatory rheology, 2% strain, 1 rad/s. Soft PA gel.
